Quick technical note: I ran a short experiment on the short-chat path. Findings:
- Tail latency spikes are correlated with cold KV cache misses and requests that force dynamic batching > 16 tokens.
- Mitigation A (increase prefix cache TTL): reduces tail by ~18% in our staging traces. Risk: higher memory use for dedicated pools.
- Mitigation B (adjust batching window): reduces average latency but increases token-cost slightly; better for bursty workloads.

Proposal: we test Mitigation A in a canary for 48hrs against a small subset of sessions and measure 95th/99th percentile. If we see a >15% reduction in 99th, we promote. I can own the canary and the tech note. Delivery Wed 3/3 EOD as requested.

Karthik
Staff SW Eng — Serving Runtime
